newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins order from Telfort.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins order from Telfort.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday it won an order from Dutch telecoms operator Telfort B.V., a joint venture of British Telecom and national Dutch railway company NS.
It said the order had an initial value of 250 million crowns.
Ericsson will build a communications network for Telfort in phases and the first phase will be finalised by July 1, 1997, when the Dutch market will be liberalised, the company said in a statement.
The initial order includes AXE switching equipment, Intelligent Network solutions, network management, as well as service solutions and training.

Telfort aims to be the alternative supplier for national and international telecoms services via its fixed network. Currently, it is a market leader in international datacoms services and has about 300 employees, Ericsson said.
